== ConLeche/Kernel/PropWhen.lean#L1-L40
     1  module
     2  
     3  public import ConLeche.Kernel.Name
     4  
     5  /-!
     6  # The zero-ness datum `PropWhen` — representation, API and laws
     7  (task #161; the small-list constructors, 2026-09-06; the canonical
     8  representation, task #194, 2026-09-06)
     9  
    10  The binder annotation of the validated-annotation design: the reading
    11  of a codomain sort's zero-ness predicate `Z(l) = {φ | eval φ l = 0}`.
    12  
    13  **This module is the datum's whole boundary.**  It owns the
    14  representation, the API that is the only way to build, read and
    15  compare a datum, and — following the `Std.HashMap` pattern that
    16  `CLAUDE.md` licenses for a self-contained data-structure verification
    17  — every law about the datum *alone*.  Downstream never re-proves them
    18  and never sees a constructor:
    19  
    20  * the readout `holds` and its algebra (`holds_inter`,
    21    `holds_bindZ_go`, `holds_ext`);
    22  * the comparison — which is **equality**: `=`/`==`/`DecidableEq`
    23    decide zero-ness agreement at every valuation (`eq_iff_holds`), so
    24    the checker's validation and defeq sites compare with `==` and no
    25    separate comparison exists (task #197 deleted `equiv`);
    26  * the `inter`/`bindZ` algebra the substitution laws rest on
    27    (`inter_assoc`, `bindZ_inter`, `bindZ_go_append`,
    28    `bindZ_congr_names`, `bindZ_unit`, `paramsDefined_inter_of`).
    29  
    30  **Canonical by construction (task #194).**  Every value of the type is
    31  the unique representative of its parameter *set*: the parameter list
    32  is strictly ascending in a total order on names (`Name.cmp`, defined
    33  here), the invariant is carried by the constructors themselves, and
    34  every producer (`ifAllZero`, `inter`, `bindZ`, hence
    35  `Level.zeronessOf`/`Level.substPW`) normalizes.  Consequently
    36  `ifAllZero ps = ifAllZero qs ↔ (∀ n, n ∈ ps ↔ n ∈ qs)`
    37  (`ifAllZero_eq_iff`), `=`/`==`/`DecidableEq`/`Hashable` all decide
    38  zero-ness agreement, and the level-instantiation identity law
    39  (`Level.substPW_self`, `ConLeche/Verify/PropWhen.lean`) holds
    40  unconditionally — amendment 2's counterexample (DESIGN.md, task #161

== ConLeche/VExpr/Syntax.lean#L165-L179
   165  inductive VExpr where
   166    /-- de Bruijn index -/
   167    | bvar (i : Nat)
   168    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
   169    | sort (u : Nat)
   170    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
   171    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
   172    /-- application -/
   173    | app (f a : VExpr)
   174    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body` -/
   175    | lam (ty body : VExpr)
   176    /-- `(_ : ty) → body` -/
   177    | pi (ty body : VExpr)
   178    /-- `let _ : ty := value; body` -/
   179    | letE (ty value body : VExpr)

== ConLeche/Semantics/Syntax.lean#L69-L86
    69  inductive AVExpr where
    70    /-- de Bruijn index -/
    71    | bvar (i : Nat)
    72    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
    73    | sort (u : Nat)
    74    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
    75    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
    76    /-- application -/
    77    | app (f a : AVExpr)
    78    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body`, where `body`'s **type** has sort `u` —
    79    the codomain numeral `interp2` dispatches on (tier B's F4; the
    80    #152 resolution made it derivable, and `Annotates.lam` caches it) -/
    81    | lam (u : Nat) (ty body : AVExpr)
    82    /-- `(_ : ty) → body`, with `ty`'s sort `u` and `body`'s sort `v` -/
    83    | pi (u v : Nat) (ty body : AVExpr)
    84    /-- `let _ : ty := value; body` — **no sort slot**, see the module
    85    docstring -/
    86    | letE (ty value body : AVExpr)

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L149-L159
   149  noncomputable def interp2 : (Nat → V) → AVExpr → V
   150    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   151    | _, .sort u => univ u
   152    | _, .const c us => bval2 V c us
   153    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp2 ρ f) (interp2 ρ a)
   154    | ρ, .lam v A b => lamR v (interp2 ρ A) fun x => interp2 (cons x ρ) b
   155    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp2 ρ A) fun x => interp2 (cons x ρ) B
   156    | ρ, .letE _ e b => interp2 (cons (interp2 ρ e) ρ) b
   157    | ρ, .eqE _ a b => eqv (interp2 ρ a) (interp2 ρ b)
   158    | ρ, .proj i e => if i = 0 then sfst (interp2 ρ e) else ssnd (interp2 ρ e)
   159    | _, .prf => pt

== ConLeche/Semantics/Ok2.lean#L78-L112
    78  def AnnotOk2 : (Nat → V) → AVExpr → Prop
    79    | ρ, .pi _u _v A B =>
    80      AnnotOk2 ρ A ∧
    81      ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp2 V ρ A → AnnotOk2 (cons x ρ) B
    82    | ρ, .lam v A b =>
    83      AnnotOk2 ρ A ∧
    84      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp2 V ρ A → AnnotOk2 (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    85      ∃ B : V → V,
    86        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp2 V ρ A → interp2 V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    87        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp2 V ρ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    88    | ρ, .app f a =>
    89      AnnotOk2 ρ f ∧ AnnotOk2 ρ a ∧
    90      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    91        interp2 V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp2 V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    92        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    93    | ρ, .letE T v b =>
    94      AnnotOk2 ρ T ∧ AnnotOk2 ρ v ∧
    95      AnnotOk2 (cons (interp2 V ρ v) ρ) b
    96    | ρ, .proj i e =>
    97      AnnotOk2 ρ e ∧ i < 2 ∧
    98      ∃ u v A Bf, interp2 V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    99        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
   100    | ρ, .eqE _ a b => AnnotOk2 ρ a ∧ AnnotOk2 ρ b
   101    | _, .bvar _ => True
   102    | _, .sort _ => True
   103    | _, .const _ _ => True
   104    | _, .prf => True
   105  
   106  /-! ### Clause equations -/
   107  
   108  @[simp] theorem AnnotOk2_bvar (ρ : Nat → V) (i : Nat) :
   109      AnnotOk2 V ρ (.bvar i) = True := by rw [AnnotOk2]
   110  @[simp] theorem AnnotOk2_sort (ρ : Nat → V) (u : Nat) :
   111      AnnotOk2 V ρ (.sort u) = True := by rw [AnnotOk2]
   112  @[simp] theorem AnnotOk2_const (ρ : Nat → V) (c : ConLeche.VExpr.BConst)

== ConLeche/Semantics/Ok2.lean#L282-L340
   282  theorem AnnotOk2_beta_pos {v : Nat} (hv : v ≠ 0) {A b a : AVExpr}
   283      {ρ : Nat → V}
   284      (h : AnnotOk2 V ρ (.app (.lam v A b) a)) :
   285      interp2 V ρ (.app (.lam v A b) a) = interp2 V ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   286      AnnotOk2 V ρ (b.inst a) := by
   287    rw [AnnotOk2_app] at h
   288    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, v', A', B', hslot, hmem, -⟩ := h
   289    rw [AnnotOk2_lam] at hlam
   290    obtain ⟨-, hbody, B, hfib, -⟩ := hlam
   291    -- the slot's product is in the graph regime: the λ is not `pt`
   292    have hv' : v' ≠ 0 := by
   293      intro h0
   294      subst h0
   295      have h1 := eq_pt_of_mem_piR_zero hslot
   296      rw [interp2_lam] at h1
   297      exact lamR_ne_pt hv h1
   298    -- rigidity pins the slot's domain to the λ's own
   299    have hown : interp2 V ρ (.lam v A b)
   300        ∈ˢ piR v (interp2 V ρ A) B := by
   301      rw [interp2_lam]
   302      exact lamR_mem hfib
   303    have hAA : interp2 V ρ A = A' := piR_dom_unique hv hv' hown hslot
   304    have haA : interp2 V ρ a ∈ˢ interp2 V ρ A := by
   305      rw [hAA]
   306      exact hmem
   307    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   308    · rw [interp2_app, interp2_lam, app_lamR_pos hv haA, interp2_inst0]
   309    · exact (AnnotOk2_inst0 V ha).mpr (hbody _ haA)
   310  
   311  /-- The graded ζ step — both conjuncts, no premises beyond the
   312  subject's invariant (ζ is annotation-free: `interp2`'s `letE` clause
   313  is already the contractum's reading). -/
   314  theorem AnnotOk2_zeta {T v b : AVExpr} {ρ : Nat → V}
   315      (h : AnnotOk2 V ρ (.letE T v b)) :
   316      interp2 V ρ (.letE T v b) = interp2 V ρ (b.inst v) ∧
   317      AnnotOk2 V ρ (b.inst v) := by
   318    rw [AnnotOk2_letE] at h
   319    obtain ⟨-, hv, hb⟩ := h
   320    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   321    · rw [interp2_letE, interp2_inst0]
   322    · exact (AnnotOk2_inst0 V hv).mpr hb
   323  
   324  /-- The graded β step at kind `0` — the residue side: with the
   325  argument membership supplied (the retained `Prop`-codomain runtime
   326  check's fact), the equality holds because both sides are the canonical
   327  proof, and the transport is the hereditary component. -/
   328  theorem AnnotOk2_beta_zero {A b a : AVExpr} {ρ : Nat → V}
   329      (h : AnnotOk2 V ρ (.app (.lam 0 A b) a))
   330      (hmem : interp2 V ρ a ∈ˢ interp2 V ρ A) :
   331      interp2 V ρ (.app (.lam 0 A b) a) = interp2 V ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   332      AnnotOk2 V ρ (b.inst a) := by
   333    rw [AnnotOk2_app] at h
   334    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, -⟩ := h
   335    rw [AnnotOk2_lam] at hlam
   336    obtain ⟨-, hbody, B, hfib, hz⟩ := hlam
   337    refine ⟨?_, (AnnotOk2_inst0 V ha).mpr (hbody _ hmem)⟩
   338    rw [interp2_app, interp2_lam, lamR_zero, app_pt, interp2_inst0]
   339    exact (eq_pt_of_mem_univZero (hz rfl _ hmem) (hfib _ hmem)).symm

== ConLeche/SetP/Annot/EnvS2Core.lean#L60-L96
    60  structure EnvS2Core (env : Env) where
    61    /-- the shared, model-free environment well-formedness -/
    62    wf : EnvWF env
    63    /-- the annotated valuation -/
    64    acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → AVExpr
    65    /-- every erased leaf is closed (`EnvS.cval_closed`, at `cvalE`);
    66    consumers read the `cvalE`-spelled `cval_closed` below -/
    67    cval_closedL : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat),
    68      VExpr.Closed ((acval n ψ).erase)
    69    /-- the reserved basis constants are the pinned declarations, valued
    70    by their direct pins (V-free, shared with the TT lane); consumers
    71    read the `cvalE`-spelled `basis_pinned` below -/
    72    basis_pinnedL : BasisPinnedTT env (fun n ψ => (acval n ψ).erase)
    73    /-- every stored native projection-table entry is a pinned pair
    74    entry with its block stored (V-free, shared) -/
    75    proj_ok : ProjOkT env
    76    /-- every stored recursor rule's constructor is stored (V-free,
    77    shared) -/
    78    rec_ctors : RecCtorsStored env
    79    /-- every leaf is closed, as a lifting equation -/
    80    acval_closed : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (k : Nat),
    81      (acval n ψ).liftN 1 k = acval n ψ
    82    /-- a leaf reads only its own level parameters -/
    83    acval_params : ∀ (n : Name) (ci : ConstantInfo),
    84      env.find? n = some ci →
    85      ∀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : Name → Nat,
    86        (∀ p ∈ ci.toConstantVal.levelParams, ψ₁ p = ψ₂ p) →
    87        acval n ψ₁ = acval n ψ₂
    88    /-- every leaf is truthful -/
    89    acval_ok2 : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
    90      AnnotOk2 V ρ (acval n ψ)
    91  
    92  variable {V}
    93  
    94  /-- **The collapsed valuation, recovered** — the re-supply the census
    95  measured at 135 sites (§1.2).  `AVExpr.erase` is a total syntactic
    96  function the carrier already owns, so no model content is

== ConLeche/SetP/Claims2P.lean#L88-L156
    88  def WhnfCoreClaims2P (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvS2Core V env)
    89      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    90    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List AVExpr},
    91      whnfCore μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    92      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    93      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    94      ∀ {ea ea' : AVExpr},
    95        CtxOkP m φ d Δa e →
    96        denoteP m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    97        denoteP m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    98        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ → AnnotOkP V ρ ea) →
    99        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ → AnnotOkP V ρ ea') ∧
   100          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ →
   101            interp2 V ρ ea = interp2 V ρ ea'
   102  
   103  /-- The reduction loop, dual success, P currency. -/
   104  def WhnfClaims2P (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvS2Core V env)
   105      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   106    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List AVExpr},
   107      whnf μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
   108      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   109      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
   110      ∀ {ea ea' : AVExpr},
   111        CtxOkP m φ d Δa e →
   112        denoteP m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   113        denoteP m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
   114        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ → AnnotOkP V ρ ea) →
   115        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ → AnnotOkP V ρ ea') ∧
   116          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ →
   117            interp2 V ρ ea = interp2 V ρ ea'
   118  
   119  /-- Definitional equality, P currency. -/
   120  def DefEqClaims2P (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvS2Core V env)
   121      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   122    ∀ {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} {Δa : List AVExpr},
   123      ConLeche.isDefEqCore μ env fuel d a b = .ok true →
   124      Expr.WScoped d a → a.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   125      Expr.LeavesBounded a →
   126      Expr.WScoped d b → b.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   127      Expr.LeavesBounded b →
   128      ∀ {aa ba : AVExpr},
   129        CtxOkP m φ d Δa a →
   130        CtxOkP m φ d Δa b →
   131        denoteP m.acval env φ d a = some aa →
   132        denoteP m.acval env φ d b = some ba →
   133        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ → AnnotOkP V ρ aa) →
   134        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ → AnnotOkP V ρ ba) →
   135        ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ →
   136          interp2 V ρ aa = interp2 V ρ ba
   137  
   138  /-- Inference, dual success, P currency: the subject's and the
   139  type's truthfulness — bit validity included — are *conclusions*. -/
   140  def InferClaims2P (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvS2Core V env)
   141      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   142    ∀ {d : Nat} {e t : Expr} {Δa : List AVExpr},
   143      inferTypeCore μ env fuel d e = .ok t →
   144      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   145      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
   146      ∀ {ea ta : AVExpr},
   147        CtxOkP m φ d Δa e →
   148        denoteP m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   149        denoteP m.acval env φ d t = some ta →
   150        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ → AnnotOkP V ρ ea) ∧
   151          (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ → AnnotOkP V ρ ta) ∧
   152          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat2 V Δa ρ →
   153            interp2 V ρ ea ∈ˢ interp2 V ρ ta
   154  
   155  /-- The P-generation step. -/
   156  def CheckStep2P (μ : CheckMode) (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] : Prop :=

== ConLeche/Kernel/Core.lean#L521-L529
   521  /-- The certified structural-`Nat` operations.  Six of them
   522  (`add sub mul pow beq ble`) carry a literal fast path; `Nat.pred` is
   523  here without one — it has no fast path (official's `reduce_nat` folds
   524  nothing unary but `Nat.succ`), but `Nat.sub`'s recurrence
   525  `sub x (succ y) = pred (sub x y)` names it, so its own recurrences
   526  must be certified for `sub`'s literal fold to be sound. -/
   527  def natOpNames : List Name :=

== ConLeche/Kernel/Core.lean#L453-L470
   453  /-! ## Structural-Nat literal acceleration
   454  
   455  The official kernel accelerates the structural `Nat` operations on
   456  literals (GMP-backed there).  Here the fast path is *certified*: an
   457  operation participates only when its defining recurrence equations
   458  hold by definitional equality — checked once, at install: `checkDecl`
   459  positively rejects a nonstandard definition under one of these names,
   460  so *presence in the store is the certificate* (no runtime flag, no
   461  re-checking; a reduction-time re-check would in fact livelock — the
   462  certification's own `pred zero` equation re-enters the fast path).
   463  
   464  The certification runs in the environment *before* the operation is
   465  stored, on the equations with the operation's self-references replaced
   466  by its (annotated) definition value (`Expr.substConst0`): running it
   467  after insertion would let the operation's own just-enabled fast path
   468  discharge its all-literal-argument equations (`pred zero ≡ zero`,
   469  `beq zero zero ≡ true`) vacuously — accepting definitions that
   470  disagree with the fast path on those points, which is unsound.  The

== ConLeche/Kernel/Checker.lean#L100-L107

   101      List (Expr × Expr) → m Bool
   102    | [] => pure true
   103    | eq :: rest => do
   104      if ← ops.isDefEq env 2 eq.1 eq.2 then
   105        certifyNatEqs ops env rest
   106      else pure false

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L91-L152
    91  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    92  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    93  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    94  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    95  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
    96  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
    97    /-- Set membership. -/
    98    Mem : V → V → Prop
    99    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   100    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   101    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   102    upair : V → V → V
   103    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   104    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   105    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   106    sUnion : V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   108    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   109    /-- Power set. -/
   110    power : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   112    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   113    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   114    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   115    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   116    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   117    image : (V → V) → V → V
   118    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   119    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   120    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   121    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   122    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   123    univChain : Nat → V
   124    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   125    next. -/
   126    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   127    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   128    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   129    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)
   130  
   131  namespace SetTheory
   132  
   133  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ∈ˢ " => Mem
   134  
   135  variable {V : Type u} [SetTheory V]
   136  
   137  /-- Subset, from membership. -/
   138  protected def Subset (x y : V) : Prop := ∀ z, z ∈ˢ x → z ∈ˢ y
   139  
   140  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ⊆ˢ " => SetTheory.Subset
   141  
   142  theorem Subset.refl (x : V) : x ⊆ˢ x := fun _ hz => hz
   143  
   144  theorem Subset.trans {x y z : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ z) : x ⊆ˢ z :=
   145    fun w hw => h₂ w (h₁ w hw)
   146  
   147  theorem Subset.antisymm {x y : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ x) : x = y :=
   148    ext fun z => ⟨h₁ z, h₂ z⟩
   149  
   150  theorem mem_power_iff_subset {z x : V} : z ∈ˢ power x ↔ z ⊆ˢ x := mem_power
   151  
   152  end SetTheory

== ConLeche/Kernel/TrustAxioms.lean#L8-L34
     8  /-!
     9  # The compiler-trust axiom family (task #95)
    10  
    11  `Init`'s compiler-trust scaffolding is installed instead of
    12  taint-skipped:
    13  
    14  * `Lean.trustCompiler : True` is trivially realizable — it is
    15    installed as an *opaque* (stored `thmInfo`, exactly like a checked
    16    `opaque` declaration) with value `True.intro`, over a pinned `True`
    17    family.  No new meta-axiom: the model is `True.intro`'s own
    18    interpretation.
    19  * `Lean.reduceNat` / `Lean.reduceBool` then check as ordinary
    20    `opaque`s (their exported values are identity functions modulo the
    21    `have := trustCompiler` wrapper); at install their stored values are
    22    pinned against the toolchain's own definitions
    23    (`ConLeche/Kernel/TrustPins.lean`, generated at build time) by
    24    definitional equality — the task-#47 pattern: drift declines,
    25    never silently.
    26  * `Lean.ofReduceNat` / `Lean.ofReduceBool` are pinned axioms over
    27    those stored opaques (the task-#34 standard-axioms machinery).  With
    28    the stored reduce operation certified to be the identity (a
    29    definitional-equality certificate at the axiom's own install,
    30    `checkOfReduceAx`), `∀ a b, reduceNat a = b → a = b` interprets to
    31    an inhabited proposition (the hypothesis *is* the conclusion), so
    32    both axioms are true in the set model with the proof point as value.
    33  
    34  `sorryAx` remains the only tolerated (skip-taint) axiom.
